newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norsk Hydro awards drilling equipment contract.
newsitem.headline: Norsk Hydro awards drilling equipment contract.

text.p: Norsk Hydro ASA said on Monday it had awarded a 180 million crown contract to Baker Oil Tools for the Viusund and Njord oil developments on the Norwegian continental shelf.
The contract covers equipment for completing wells and for well securement.
Tananger-based Baker Oil Tools could earn up to 1.3 billion crowns if the Hydro takes up all options included in the deal, a spokesman for Norsk Hydro said.
The Njord prospect in the Norwegian Sea is due to come on stream in autumn 1997, while the North Sea Visund field is scheduled to start producing in mid-1998.
Baker Oil Tools is a daughter company of U.S.-based Baker Hughes Inc.
